map.为什么利润要扣货成本？: Why deduct goods cost from profit?
map.收入不是利润，卖货还要付进货/生产成本。不扣货成本会把 ROI 算高，误导预算决: Revenue is not profit, since selling goods means paying purchase or production cost. Skipping goods cost inflates ROI and misleads budget decisions.
map.ROI 和 ROAS 哪个更该看？: Which matters more, ROI or ROAS?
map.ROAS 看广告效率，ROI 看真实盈利。长期决策应优先 ROI，ROAS 仅作: ROAS shows advertising efficiency while ROI shows true profitability. For long-term decisions prioritize ROI and use ROAS only for real-time campaign monitoring.
map.ROI = (广告收入 - 广告花费 - 商品成本) / 广告花费 × 100%: ROI = (attributed revenue − ad spend − COGS) / ad spend × 100%, excluding indirect costs such as operations and payroll
map.商品成本率用于估算真实利润，未考虑运营、人力等其他费用；广告花费须大于 0: The COGS rate estimates real profit and ignores other costs such as operations and payroll; ad spend must be greater than 0
map.不一定。收入还要覆盖商品成本，盈亏平衡 ROAS = 1 ÷ (1 − 商品成本: No. Revenue must also cover COGS; break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ (1 − COGS rate), so a 70% cost rate needs ROAS ≥ 3.33 to avoid a loss.
map.广告花费须大于 0，否则 ROI / ROAS 无定义。: Ad spend must be greater than 0; otherwise ROI and ROAS are undefined.
map.转化数须为非负数（选填，可留空）。: Conversions must be non-negative (optional, may be blank).
map.商品/服务成本率须在 0–100% 之间。: The COGS rate must be between 0 and 100%.
map.ROAS ≥ 盈亏平衡值，广告本身未亏损: ROAS is at or above break-even, so the campaign itself is not losing money
map.ROAS 低于盈亏平衡值，广告实际亏损: ROAS is below break-even, so the campaign is losing money
map.成本率 100% 时不存在盈亏平衡 ROAS: At a 100% cost rate there is no break-even ROAS
map.ROAS = 广告收入 / 广告花费；是否亏损取决于成本率，盈亏平衡 ROAS: ROAS = attributed revenue / ad spend; whether you lose money depends on the cost rate. Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ (1 − COGS rate), and below that even ROAS > 1 loses money
map.不一定。收入还要覆盖商品成本，: No. Revenue must also cover COGS;
map.ROAS = 1 ÷ (1 − 商品成本率)；成本率 70% 时需 ROAS ≥: ROAS = 1 ÷ (1 − COGS rate), so a 70% cost rate needs ROAS ≥ 3.33 to avoid a loss.
